sn4.19:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
sn4.19:1.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
sn4.19:2.2: ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo bhikkhū nibbānapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya. pe.
sn4.19:2.3: yannūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyāti.
sn4.19:2.4: atha kho māro pāpimā kassakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantaṃ naṅgalaṃ khandhe karitvā dīghaṃ pācanayaṭṭhiṃ gahetvā haṭahaṭakeso sāṇasāṭakanivattho kaddamamakkhitehi pādehi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn4.19:2.7: mameva samaṇa cakkhu mama rūpā mama cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ
sn4.19:2.9: mameva samaṇa sotaṃ mama saddā. pe.
sn4.19:2.10: mameva samaṇa ghānaṃ mama gandhā. pe.
sn4.19:2.11: mameva samaṇa jivhā mama rasā. pe.
sn4.19:2.12: mameva samaṇa kāyo mama phoṭṭhabbā. pe.
sn4.19:2.13: mameva samaṇa mano mama dhammā mama manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ
sn4.19:3.1: taveva pāpima cakkhuṃ tava rūpā tava cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ

sn4.19:3.3: taveva pāpima sotaṃ tava saddā tava sotasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ
sn4.19:3.4: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi sotaṃ natthi saddā natthi sotasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ agati tava tattha pāpima
sn4.19:3.5: taveva pāpima ghānaṃ tava gandhā tava ghānasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ

sn4.19:3.7: taveva pāpima jivhā tava rasā tava jivhāsamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ . pe.
sn4.19:3.8: taveva pāpima kāyo tava phoṭṭhabbā tava kāyasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ. pe.
sn4.19:3.9: taveva pāpima mano tava dhammā tava manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ
